key_insight: SKFitter converts first-principles calculations into symmetry-resolved, physically interpretable tight-binding models that capture complex orbital, spin–orbit, and magnetic effects.
engineering_relevance: The open-source Python framework enables compact electronic-structure models for evaluating spin transport, magnetic responses, and topological properties.
method: Fit symmetry-resolved Slater–Koster parameters to Quantum ESPRESSO or VASP calculations.
Support s–f orbitals, on-site spin–orbit coupling, site-resolved exchange, and orthogonal or nonorthogonal bases.
Refine orbital bases using projection diagnostics and optimize fits with weighting.
evidence_signal: Across eight representative materials, reported band-energy errors are 9–41 meV within 1 eV of the Fermi level; orbital refinement reduces the EuMn2Bi2 near-Fermi error from 120 to 32 meV.
watch_item: Accuracy depends on orbital-basis selection and fitting weights; near-Fermi band agreement alone does not establish accuracy for all derived responses.
paper_title: SKFitter: Symmetry resolved Slater Koster tight-binding models from first principles for s, p, d and f electrons, spin orbit coupling and magnetism
